    AI Overview
    Kentucky defeated Santa Clara 89-84 in a 2026 NCAA Tournament first-round overtime thriller on March 20, 2026, in St. Louis. No. 7 seed Kentucky (22-13) overcame a 10th-seeded Santa Clara (26-9) side that led at halftime and held a late lead before {Link: Otega Oweh
    hit a buzzer-beating three-pointer to force OT.} 
    Game Timeline: March 20, 2026 (NCAA Tournament First Round) 
    • Halftime: Santa Clara led 31-29 after a tight first half, featuring 10 points from Elijah Mahi, according to Santa Clara Broncos.
    • 12:21 Second Half: A 13-4 run put Kentucky ahead 51-44 after back-to-back 3s from Collin Chandler and Aberdeen, per CBS Sports.
    • 7:56 Second Half: Santa Clara responded with a 15-4 run to lead 59-55, fueled by three-pointers from Sash Gavalyugov and Mahi, as reported by CBS Sports.
    • 2.4 Seconds Left (Regulation): Santa Clara's Allen Graves hit a 3-pointer from the right wing, putting the Broncos ahead 73-70, notes ESPN.
    • 0:00 Second Half: Kentucky's Otega Oweh hit a banked-in 3-pointer from near half-court at the buzzer to tie the game at 73, according to ESPN.
    • Overtime: Oweh hit crucial free throws to lead Kentucky past the Broncos 89-84, says UK Athletics. 
    Top Performers 
    • Kentucky: Otega Oweh (led the team, massive performance).
    • Santa Clara: Elijah Mahi (10 pts in 1st half), Sash Gavalyugov, and Allen Graves.
